reviews.text: I had the most heartbreaking decision to make in regards to saying goodbye to my Ben who had been with me for 18 years.   Thank goodness I found Hiram.  He was so lovely & respectful to Ben, my heart breaks writing this. If  you ever need a true & respectful vet, Hiram is your man.  Thank you Hiram 🙏🏻🙏🏻

The kindness patience&compassionate nature of the female vet was truly exceptional.The whole process was organised for us by Vets at home in Kirkintilloch Glasgow.
Thank you for the care of our beloved dog  🐕 Thane who gave us 13 yrs of ❤️ loyalty. I Highly recommend this Service.

We had to contact Vets at Home and Heart as we had to make the awful decision to put our 15yr old pet dog Buster to sleep.
Hiram answered my call on a Saturday afternoon and showed genuine care and compassion.  He was able to come to our home on the Sunday and made a very sad occasion much more bearable. Hiram was professional and had a lovely calming influence towards Buster and the whole family.  We will be forever grateful to have found Hiram and would highly recommend this peaceful ending to anyone who has to make this difficult decision. The whole process was dealt with by Hiram which made a very difficult time, far easier for us all.

Thank you for making a very difficult day a little easier. The passing of the wee cat was very peaceful.

Update August 2026
Sadly, I've had to use this wonderful service again, this time to help my second cat pass peacefully at home. Not having to go to the vet practice to have him go to sleep was a great relief for both of us. Many thanks again.

The kindest goodbye, from a truly compassionate and caring vet.

I cannot thank Hiram enough for the kindness, compassion and empathy he showed us when he came to our home on 21 August to help us say goodbye to our beloved Yoshi.

Yoshi had cancer and, although he had already let me know that he was ready to go, he was struggling to walk and no longer wanted to play. Knowing it was the right decision didn’t make it any easier. In fact, it was the hardest decision I have ever had to make and the saddest day of my life.

From the moment Hiram arrived, his calm, gentle and compassionate manner gave us some comfort during an incredibly painful time. Yoshi trusted him immediately and was genuinely happy to see him, which meant so much to us. Hiram treated Yoshi with such gentleness and respect, and he explained everything to us carefully and kindly, so that we knew what to expect without ever feeling rushed.

Afterwards, Hiram gave us all the time we needed to be with Yoshi, say our goodbyes and have those precious final moments together. There was no sense of being hurried, and that kindness is something I will always be grateful for.

He then gently took Yoshi with him to the crematorium, and knowing that he was in such caring hands for his final journey gave us some peace on an unbearably sad day.

Hiram is a truly wonderful vet. His calmness, kindness, compassion and empathy made one of the most heartbreaking experiences imaginable a little easier to bear. I will never forget the way he cared for Yoshi, or the kindness he showed to us.

Thank you, Hiram, for helping us give our beautiful boy the peaceful and dignified goodbye he deserved. We will always be grateful.
Went above and beyond for my xl bully ace cannot thank you enough talked us through the whole process which made it so much easier thank you hiram

I would like to say a huge thank you to Harim at Vets at Home and Heart for the compassion, kindness and care you showed to our amazing 13 year old boy Oscar last week.
Hiram was wonderful, calm and empathetic as we dealt with the most horrendous decision that any pet owner faces.
I wholeheartedly recommend the services of this company.

Thank you Hiram for helping our beloved Molly have a peaceful death.
Arranging a home visit was straightforward with transparent pricing and information. We were able to ask any questions and when Hiram attended he took time to explain in appropriate language what would happen. He had a gentle an compassionate manner with Molly and made us feel confident that she was in good hands.

Hiram struck a perfect balance between professionalism and compassionate, which made it easy to trust him. He took such good care of my baby in our home euthanasia appointment and explained everything clearly, also offering us space and time before the final injection. I also found the pricing to be perfectly reasonable, and better than previous euthanasia services I've had to use (and those one's weren't at home!). Thank you Hiram and the rest of the staff for your gold standard care and support. Vets at Home and Heart provide a wonderful service and I would really recommend them to anyone who's pet is at the end stage of their life.

would like to say a huge thank you to Harim at Vets at Home and Heart for the kindness, compassion, and care you showed to our beautiful Ella on 26th June, you came to our home and let Ella leave with such dignity and love ❤️ The calm and peaceful way you helped Ella pass at home meant so much to us. Being able to say goodbye in a familiar place, surrounded by love, was something we will always be grateful for. Also the empathy you showed towards myself and my 2 adult children will never be forgotten, absolutely outstanding service and professionalism thank you so much, also for the card I received and the flower seeds to plant in memory of her, greatly appreciated
I cannot speak highly enough of Hiram and Vets at Home and Heart. The service and communication was impeccable and my beautiful little Lilith passed peacefully in my arms. I cannot fault the service

We are incredibly grateful for the service provided by Vets at Home and Heart, we reached out on a day marked as closed and we received a response within the hour.
The vet that came out to our house was very kind, patient, thoughtful and explained each step of the process to make sure my wife and I were comfortable.
This precious service allowed us to spend our last moments with our Oscar to be comfortable and peaceful.
Hiram was our at home vet for our two reactive Labradors whilst we lived in the Glasgow area and his service was fantastic. Hiram is a compassionate, friendly and excellent vet. 110% recommend 👍 …

Hiram attended our house yesterday to help our beloved mia cross the rainbow bridge, I would say she had a good death thanks to hirams help. He was professional, empathetic and has a true caring nature toward animals. It was such a relaxed non hurried event and to have your dog pass in the comfort of your own home makes the world of difference to everyone involved, no waiting in waiting room at vets knowing your not going to be walking back out of there with your dog whilst you sit and watch others leave with theirs and No stressed dog. If you get the opportunity to plan your dogs passing I.e not an emergency then seriously consider home euthanasia you won't regret it.  Thankyou vets at home and heart for the truly invaluable service you provide at end of life.

I honestly don’t have the words, but I need to say thank you to Hiram from the bottom of my heart.

Letting my beautiful boy Rambo go was the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do, but you made it as peaceful and gentle as it could possibly be. Rambo was in his own home, in his favourite place, surrounded by the people who loved him most—and that means everything to me.

The way you treated him… with such kindness, dignity and genuine love… I’ll never forget it. You didn’t just do your job, you truly cared, and that showed in every moment. You gave Rambo the most calm and loving goodbye, and you gave us the time and space to hold him, talk to him, and tell him how much he meant to us.

He wasn’t just a dog—he was my comfort, my strength, my shadow through some of the hardest times in my life. Saying goodbye to him has broken my heart, but I’ll always be grateful that his last moments were filled with love, peace, and no fear.

Thank you for giving my boy the goodbye he deserved. I will carry that with me forever 🤍
Hiram was professional from start to finish, we couldn’t have asked for more. Everything was exactly the way we asked for, really appreciated everything on a really difficult day.

We are so incredibly grateful to Pets at Home and Heart for the care and compassion they showed when we had to say goodbye to our beloved Alfie.

Being able to have Alfie put to sleep at home, in a place where he felt safe and comfortable, meant everything to us. It made such a heartbreaking moment just that little bit more peaceful, knowing he was surrounded by love in familiar surroundings.

Hiram, the vet who came to see us, was truly wonderful. He was so kind, gentle, and respectful throughout the entire process. He took the time to answer all of our questions with patience and understanding, never making us feel rushed, and made sure we fully understood everything that was happening. His calm and compassionate manner brought us a lot of comfort during such an emotional time.

He also took care of all the administrative side of things, including arranging Alfie’s cremation with Glasgow Pet Cremations, which lifted a huge weight off our shoulders. It allowed us to focus on saying goodbye without worrying about the practicalities.

A week later, we received a lovely card along with some forget-me-not seeds, which was such a thoughtful and touching gesture. It really meant a lot to us and showed how much they truly care beyond the appointment itself.

We will always be thankful for the dignity, kindness, and respect they showed Alfie and us. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend their service to anyone facing the same difficult decision.

We unfortunately had to make the decision to put our best boy Rocco down as cancer had taken over, even though he was only 5 years old. Hiram was absolutely fantastic and I honestly could not recommend him enough, he made a horrible situation more bearable and the fact our boy got to cross the rainbow bridge while in his favourite spot on the couch was a massive bonus for us. I will be using hiram again without a doubt if/when the time comes for our other dog. Thank you so much again for everything

I can’t thank hiram enough. Me and my family dreaded today but Hiram was respectful of what we wanted for our fur babie he made sure storm was comfy he gave us our time to say goodbye. As much as our heart is breaking Hiram stopped my fur babie suffering and sent him over the rainbow.

Unfortunately recently we had to have our dog age 14 pit to sleep. We were recommended these guys  and I cannot thank and recommend  enough. The vet came to our home and was very reassuring throughout the procedure. I am so glad we said goodbye to our boy at home. Thanks again for all you did for us in this trying time.
They are so kind and considerate. Caring and compassionate.  They looked after our little Missy with so much dignity care. Highly, highly recommend them in your hour of need. Many, many thanks.

Dreaded this day but knew it was best for Bella. Hiram was fantastic, very caring and empathetic.
Strange thing was that Bella didn’t like strangers especially men and I was a bit worried about how she would react towards Hiram. She didn’t bark or growl and went to him nuzzled his hands. I was taken aback and also relieved.
Everything was so peaceful and I wasn’t left with the images of her shaking anxious like she  usually was when taken to the vet.
Would recommend this gentle process to anyone who is thinking about loving pets final moments.

Harim was amazing with our boy Bailey
Having him come to our home & put our boy to rest, he had lots of treats, surrounded by family & love & fell sleep with dignity.. Thank you so much

I want to express my deepest gratitude to this veterinarian, who showed incredible compassion during one of the most heartbreaking moments of my life. When my dog was in crisis, he immediately set out to come help. Even though my dog passed away before he arrived, he stayed in contact with me the entire time, sending caring and supportive messages, thank you Hiram.

We had our best friend Aggie put to sleep on Monday and couldn't have asked for a better experience given the circumstances. Hiram was professional and compassionate and made us feel very much at ease. Aggie passed comfortably at home surround by love. Thank you so much for making this horrible time easier for us.

I couldn't have had a better experience. Right from the first phone call I was met with empathy and care. Hiram is exceptionally compassionate and went out of his way when I needed an emergency appointment after my beautiful cat Gizmo had a catastrophic stroke. Hiram responded immediately and rearranged his schedule to accommodate my need. Everything was handled in a highly professional and caring manner. I cannot recommend Hiram and his services enough. We will miss our cat terribly.

Hiram was so incredibly compassionate and professional during his visit with us. He spent time with us and even within a few short minutes knew how ill our cat Skye really was. Considering we had had quite a negative experience with our own vet up until that point, he restored our faith and gave our gorgeous girl peace when she needed it most. We are still incredibly upset that we lost our girl much too soon but are reassured we did the right thing bringing Hiram into our home.

I am so thankful that I chose Vets at Home & Heart for my precious whippet, Tinker Bell's end of life. Harim showed great warmth and empathy towards my whole family and Tinker Bell. He explained everything simply of what to expect and always responded promptly with any questions and concerns.

Amazing service from start to finish to help us say goodbye to our old boy, called to check in, kept me informed at all stages and on the day our dog Rogue was given the best care ensuring his death was dignified, he was at ease and in the arms of them that loved him most. We were able to spend time with him in private and he was taken away on the comfort of his own bed, cant fault this company. We even received a heartfelt card and gift afterwards in the post, thanks again!

Hiram came out to see our cat, Eddie Bear. Initially, it was a senior cat assessment that unfortunately, turned into letting him go over the rainbow bridge.

Hiram was nothing but kind, thoughtful and caring in Eddie’s final moments. I am so grateful he allowed Eddie the dignified ending he deserved.

Hiram attended our home to assist us with our 5 year old dog Ralph ,who had cancer which had spread. Hiram was a calming presence for us at this very difficult time. He explained every stage clearly & did not rush us. His presence was reassuring but not intrusive. Would recommend this service.

Where do i start with this one. I was advised by my local vet to have my precious old boy put to sleep. Prematurely in my opinion. Thank goodness Harim was recommended to me. This man is an angel on earth. As soon as he arrived, his manner, presence and love for animals made me know i made the right choice. My Mickey loved him. Harim didn't give up on mickey just yet, he helped him and i mean truly help him by giving him a comfortable life and understanding Mickeys condition so well we managed another couple of moths with the my old man🖤 i felt Harim really new Mickey and had his best interest at heart. When the time came for us to make that dreaded decision, Harim really made the process bearable. He is so nurturing and respectful it is admirable. Mickey went to sleep full of his fave treats and family around him. The hardest goodbye ever.

Harim you are a wonderful human! Thank you for everything with Mickey. We will be forever grateful.

I cannot praise Hiram enough for his attention last Friday. My old dog, Jet, had come to the end of her life and needed some help at this awful time. Hiram was so incredibly compassionate and caring. The whole procedure was was handled in a most professional way. We were not rushed. He stayed for an hour. Jet was in her own home, not scared, knew nothing at all about what was going on and was delighted to spend time with this most kindly visitor. It was perfect. Thank you so much Hiram.

Hiram came to our home to health check and vaccinate our 3 house cats who’s previous vet experiences have been quite traumatic.

He was absolutely excellent. The process was very relaxed and unrushed, showing so much care and kindness for our cats, they barely even knew they’d had a vet visit and thought they’d just made a new friend.
Such a stark difference to every vet experience I’ve ever had, he even provided explanations of everything he was doing as he carried out the health checks which was brilliant.
Perfect experience all round, thanks so much 🙂

I would like to thank Hiram for his kindness and gentle touch when it was time for my old girl Ripley to go over Rainbow bridge on Thursday evening. As devastating as it is to lose a beloved pet, Hirams calm and caring manner made it all the easier for Ripley to pass peacefully, which in turn helped me.  Letting your pet pass peacefully at home in their own bed is so much better for all concerned.  Hiram also organised for Ripley to be collected by Pet Cremation Glasgow.  I had a whole hour to sit with Ripley before they collected her, which was precious and meant a lot to me.  I was even able to carry her out to the car which again meant a lot.  So again, thank you Hiram from the bottom of my heart for all you did for Ripley in her last moments.

I would like to thank vets at home and heart, my dog of 16 years Zarah wanted to say goodbye, I didn't want her last memories to be having to struggle getting her into the car, while she was in pain.

So I messaged and im so happy I did, it's such a hard thing to do but all I can say is it was a little easier using vets at home, I will be forever grateful for the help I received.

Zarah is at peace now, cremated and her ashes will be going in to a memory bear for my 5 year old daughter (and me).

Thank you again.
Stephen Murdoch
Port Glasgow

Would highly recommend.

Saying goodbye to my beloved Lady today was the hardest thing I’ve ever had to do. I was heartbroken and extremely anxious, but Hiram’s calm and gentle presence brought comfort the moment he arrived. Lady, who is usually reserved, sought affection from him—which told me she felt safe and at peace.

Her passing was calm, dignified, and full of love. I’ll always be grateful to Hiram for his compassion, patience, and the care he showed us both. Thank you for helping me give Lady the peaceful goodbye she deserved. ❤️

On behalf of my family and I, we just want to say a massive thank you to Hiram.
This was the hardest thing my family and I have ever ever had to do.
We were all very apprehensive, having never done anything like this before and only wanting the best for our boy Frankie.
As soon as Hiram arrived, his calming presence and kind manner instantly put us all at ease. Frankie likes to take his time to get to know people but instantly got excited and wanted petted from Hiram. He was happy and kept pawing Hiram for more attention.
This was a moment we knew Frankie was telling us how comfortable he was with him.
This whole procedure even thouh extremely hard on our hearts, went smooth and was so peaceful for Frankie.
He slipped into a beautiful sleep with a big smile on his face.
Thank you so much for everything. You truly helped give Frankie the send off he deserves.
Thank you for being so kind and understanding with all of us. We had a million questions and you answered every one of them with the delicacy it needed.
If anyone is going through this heartbreaking time with their furbabies then my family and I recommend  Hiram and at Pets at home and heart 100%

Last week, I had to make the incredibly difficult decision to say goodbye to my dog , Cali. I want to take a moment to thank Hiram for the compassion, professionalism, and genuine care he showed during such a painful time.

From the moment we arrived, Hiram treated Cali with such gentleness and respect. He explained everything clearly and gave us the time and space we needed to say our goodbyes. His calm presence helped make an unbearable situation just a little bit more bearable.

I’ll never forget how peaceful he made her passing feel. Cali was calm and comforted, and that gave me a great sense of peace too.

Thank you, Hiram, for helping her leave this world with dignity and for being there for us when we needed it most. Your kindness truly meant the world to me.

It is never a good time to part with your best friend. 16 years worth of memories will stay in our hearts. Thank you to BumBum for choosing us to be her human companions. Massive thank you to Hiram for all his help to get us through a very difficult and emotional day.
